dossier.headline: Iran's Hormuz offer awaits a US answer
dossier.summary: Iran has sent a Qatar-mediated proposal that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for sanctions relief and an end to the US naval blockade. The US is reviewing it and Trump says talks are going well, but Washington also imposed fresh Iran-related sanctions on Friday and no deal has been reached.
why_it_matters: Hormuz access drives crude, India's biggest import-cost risk
A deal would ease supply fears that kept oil near $100 earlier in the autumn
